NONE: › the sound that is made when something heavy falls or hits something else
砰的一聲；重擊聲；沉悶的聲響

example: The boy fell to the ground with a thud.
男孩重重地摔倒在地上。
I could hear the thud of horses' hoofs down the dirt road.
我可以聽到泥道上響起的馬蹄聲。

NONE: › a man who acts violently, especially to commit a crime

example: Some thugs smashed his windows.
幾個惡棍打碎了他的窗戶。

NONE: B1 the short, thick finger on the side of your hand that makes it possible to hold and pick things up easily
› to stand near the edge of a road and hold out your hand with the thumb raised as a signal for a vehicle to stop and take you somewhere
豎起拇指要求免費搭車
› to show no respect, or to raise the end of your thumb to the end of your nose to show that you do not respect someone

example: We thumbed a lift to London.
我們搭便車去了倫敦。
He has thumbed his nose at authority all his life.
他一生都藐視權威。

NONE: › to turn the pages of a book, magazine, or a document quickly and only read small parts of it

example: "Have you read the report?" "Well, I thumbed through it quickly while I was eating breakfast."
「你看過報告了嗎？」「嗯，我在吃早飯時匆匆翻閱過。」

C: › a small picture of an image or page on a computer screen

NONE: › a short description mentioning only the most important features
› used to show disapproval of something

example: They gave our plan the thumbs down (= they have disagreed with our plan).
他們不贊成我們的計劃。

NONE: › used to show approval of something

example: So it's the thumbs up for Brighton's latest nightclub.
那麼這就是對布賴頓最近開的那家夜總會表示認可了。

NONE: › a device used especially in the past to torture people (= cause them great pain) by crushing their thumbs
› a short, sharp pin with a flat, round top, used especially for putting up notices
› to hit something and cause a noise
› the sound of something heavy hitting something
砰然落下；物體落下的聲音
› UK an act of thumping someone or something
› UK to hit someone with your fist (= closed hand)
› UK If your head thumps, you can feel pain in strong beats in your head.
› If your heart thumps, it beats more strongly and quickly than usual, because of exercise, fear, or excitement.

example: Someone was thumping on the door.
有人在使勁敲門。
He thumped him in the face.
他一拳狠狠打在他的臉上。
When I woke up my mouth was dry and my head was thumping.
我醒來時口乾舌燥、頭痛欲裂。
She stood outside his room, her heart thumping.
她站在他的房門外，心怦怦直跳。
She fell to the floor with a thump.
她重重地摔倒在地上。
If he does that again I'm going to give him a thump (= hit him with my closed hand).
如果他再那樣做，我要好好揍他一頓。

NONE: › a bad headache that is felt in strong, painful beats

example: a thumping defeat/victory
慘敗／輝煌的勝利
They won by a thumping majority.
他們以絕對多數獲勝。
I'm not carrying that thumping great thing around with me!
我可不會隨身帶著那個笨重的大傢夥！

U: B1 [ U ] the sudden loud noise that comes from the sky especially during a storm

I: › [ I ] When it thunders, a loud noise comes from the sky.
I + adv/prep: › [ I + adv/prep ] to move, making a lot of noise

example: a clap of thunder
一聲雷響
I couldn't hear what he was saying over the thunder of the waterfall.
瀑布震天響，我聽不清他說的話。
The sky grew dark and it started to thunder.
天色變暗，開始打雷了。
The train thundered past, shaking the whole house.
火車轟隆隆駛過，整座房子都晃動起來。
[ + speech ] "I never want to see you here again!" he thundered.
「我再也不想在這裡見到你！」他怒吼道。

C: › [ C ] a flash of lightning and the sound of thunder together

S: › [ S ] an announcement, event, or idea that is completely unexpected or shocking
晴天霹靂；出人意料的突發事件；令人震驚的情況

example: The news of the layoffs was a thunderbolt that left us all reeling.
裁員的消息對於我們猶如晴天霹靂。

NONE: › a single loud sound of thunder
› a large, dark cloud that produces thunder and lightning

example: a thunderous reception
熱烈的反響

NONE: A2 a storm with thunder and lightning and usually heavy rain
極其震驚的；目瞪口呆的

example: Ruth was thunderstruck when he presented her with an engagement ring.
當他掏出一隻訂婚戒指給露絲時，露絲都呆住了。

NONE: › used to describe weather or a storm, etc. in which there is thunder
A1 the day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday

example: I'm getting my hair cut after work on Thursday.
星期四下班後我去理髮。
The shops stay open late on Thursdays.
商店在星期四較晚關門。
Bye! See you next Thursday!
再見！下星期四見！
Do you remember that book we were talking about last Thursday?
你還記得我們上星期四談論的那本書嗎？
This year my birthday is on a Thursday.
今年我的生日在星期四。
Thursday morning/afternoon/evening/night
星期四上午／下午／傍晚/晚上

NONE: › as far as this or until now

example: Bend from the waist, thus.
彎腰，就這樣。
They planned to reduce staff and thus to cut costs.
他們計劃裁員，從而達到降低成本的目的。
We haven't had any problems thus far.
我們至今沒有出現任何問題。
He summed up the challenge thusly: "The team has a big mountain to climb."
他這樣總結面臨的挑戰：「團隊面前有一座大山需要跨越」。
